name: How can I make my rental property more energy-efficient during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my rental property more energy-efficient during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a renovation, several upgrades can significantly improve energy efficiency. Consider replacing old windows and doors with energy-efficient models. Upgrading to LED lighting throughout the property can drastically reduce electricity consumption. Improve insulation in walls, attics, and crawl spaces. Install energy-efficient appliances and a smart thermostat for better climate control. These improvements not only reduce utility costs for tenants, making your property more attractive, but also contribute to long-term savings for the property owner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Enhance energy efficiency during renovation by upgrading to LED lighting, improving insulation, installing energy-efficient windows/appliances, and adding smart thermostats.
